components.name: Diagram/Agent node
components.description: One step of an automation or AI-agent workflow (n8n-style canvas, BEK AI agents). Icon tile (swap Icon), title, step type, status Badge and one meta line; input/output ports sit on the vertical centre for Diagram/Connector. Running = border/accent ring, Error = border/danger ring + reason in text/danger. React: <AgentNode title type icon status="idle|running|success|error" meta />
